seo.title: CPS Test - Check Your Click Speed
seo.description: How fast can you click? Take the 10-second CPS Test. Challenge your friends and beat the World Record.

content.h2_hook: Why Every Millisecond Matters in Gaming
content.p_hook: In the world of competitive gaming, your Click Per Second (CPS) rate is often the dividing line between victory and defeat. Whether you are bridging in Minecraft Bedwars or trying to out-DPS a boss in an MMO, raw click speed is a fundamental skill.
content.p_science: This test measures your input speed with millisecond precision using the performance.now() API. It eliminates browser lag to give you a true raw score. Most players average 6-8 CPS, while pros exceed 12 CPS.
content.p_gaming: High CPS reduces the knockback you take in Minecraft 1.8 PvP. By clicking faster, you send more packets to the server, which can reset your velocity and allow you to start combos easier.
content.p_hardware: To achieve 20+ CPS, hardware matters. Optical switches (like in Razer mice) prevent double-clicking, while mechanical switches (Omron) can be abused for drag clicking.
content.p_technique: Jitter clicking vibrates your arm muscles to hit 10-14 CPS. Butterfly clicking uses two fingers on one wide button to hit 20 CPS. Both require practice.

q1.question: What is reaction time?
q1.answer: The time it takes for your brain to process a visual signal and respond.

q2.question: What is a good reaction time?
q2.answer: Average is 250ms. Below 200ms is excellent. Pro gamers often hit 150ms.

q3.question: How to improve reflexes?
q3.answer: Practice regularly, get enough sleep, stay hydrated, and play fast-paced games like FPS.

q4.question: Does age affect reaction time?
q4.answer: Yes, reaction time tends to peak in your 20s and gradually slows down with age.

q5.question: Does monitor Hz affect reaction?
q5.answer: Yes, a 144Hz or 240Hz monitor reduces input lag significantly compared to 60Hz.

q6.question: What is visual reaction time?
q6.answer: Response time to a visual stimulus.

q7.question: What is auditory reaction time?
q7.answer: Response time to sound, usually faster than visual.

q8.question: Can caffeine improve reaction?
q8.answer: Yes, in moderate amounts it can increase alertness.

q9.question: Do pro gamers use special gear?
q9.answer: Yes, high refresh rate monitors and low latency mice.

q1.question: What is WPM?
q1.answer: Words Per Minute measures typing speed.

q2.question: How to type faster?
q2.answer: Practice touch typing, maintain good posture, and avoid looking at the keyboard.

q3.question: What is a good WPM?
q3.answer: Average is 40 WPM. Professional typists reach 100+ WPM.

q4.question: Is touch typing better?
q4.answer: Yes, it allows you to type without looking at keys, drastically increasing speed.

q5.question: What is a mechanical keyboard?
q5.answer: A keyboard with physical switches for each key.

q6.question: Does keyboard affect typing speed?
q6.answer: Yes, tactile feedback helps maintain rhythm.

q7.question: How to learn touch typing?
q7.answer: Start with home row exercises and practice daily.

q9.question: What is 100% accuracy?
q9.answer: Typing without any errors or backspaces.

q10.question: How to reduce typing fatigue?
q10.answer: Use a wrist rest and keep good posture.

q1.question: What is Ghosting?
q1.answer: When a keyboard fails to register multiple simultaneous key presses.

q2.question: What is Key Rollover?
q2.answer: The maximum number of keys that can be pressed at once.

q3.question: How do I test my keys?
q3.answer: Press every key on your keyboard and ensure it lights up green on the screen.

q4.question: How to test mechanical switches?
q4.answer: Press keys gently to check actuation point vs bottoming out.

q5.question: What is N-Key Rollover?
q5.answer: Ability to register all keys pressed simultaneously.

q6.question: What are Cherry MX switches?
q6.answer: Popular mechanical switches with different feels.

q7.question: How to clean a keyboard?
q7.answer: Use compressed air and remove keycaps.

q8.question: Why is my key sticking?
q8.answer: It might be dirty or the switch is broken.

q9.question: What is a membrane keyboard?
q9.answer: A keyboard using pressure pads, usually cheaper.

q10.question: Can I replace laptop keys?
q10.answer: Yes, but it is delicate work.

q1.question: What is a Dead Pixel?
q1.answer: A pixel that does not light up (black).

q2.question: What is Ghost Touch?
q2.answer: Screen registering touches you didn't make.

q3.question: How to fix stuck pixels?
q3.answer: Rapidly flashing colors can sometimes unstuck them.

q1.question: Why is my mic quiet?
q1.answer: Check your input gain in settings.

q2.question: Gamepad not detected?
q2.answer: Press a button to wake it up.

q1.question: What is Packet Loss?
q1.answer: Data failing to reach the server, causing lag.

seo.title: Touch Screen Test Online (ZH-TW)
seo.description: [Localized] Check your phone or tablet screen for dead zones and ghost touches.

content.p_hook: Ghost touches and dead zones can ruin your mobile gaming experience. This full-screen diagnostic tool helps you identify unresponsive areas on your digitizer.
content.p_science: Modern capacitive screens use a grid of electrodes. When you touch, you alter the electrical field. This test visualizes that raw data trail.
content.p_gaming: In games like PUBG Mobile or Free Fire, a dead zone means your aim gets stuck. Use this test to verify if your screen edges are responsive.
content.p_hardware: Check for discoloration or burn-in artifacts while using the white background mode of this test.
content.p_technique: Clean your screen, remove screen protectors, or discharge static electricity. If issues persist, the digitizer hardware is likely faulty.
